title: Speak Like a Presenter: Voice, Pace and Body Language
objective: Students practice delivery skills that make biology content easier to follow.
phrases: I will explain this step by step.
outcomes: Use natural gestures and eye contact.
activity: Delivery drill: say one result sentence three ways - too fast, too flat, then clear and natural.
example: When saying “polymerase chain reaction,” the presenter slows down, pauses, and then explains “PCR” in simpler words.
